description: Use this when someone asks how fast US online stores are right now, or wants a current benchmark to compare a store against. Returns 7IT's weekly US Store Speed Index: median Google phone score, time to main content, share of stores scoring 50 or more, and median apps per store for a fixed panel of 100 US online stores, week by week, with the source link. Medians only; no store is named.
name: get_store_speed_index

panel.description: Number of stores in the fixed panel

series.description: One entry per week, oldest first

median_apps.description: Median third-party apps and tags per store

median_lcp_s.description: Median seconds until the main content shows

median_score.description: Median Google phone performance score, 0 to 100

score_50_plus.description: Percent of stores scoring 50 or more

updated.description: Date of the latest weekly reading, YYYY-MM-DD

title: US Store Speed Index (weekly)
